title: The CEO's Hidden Love
hook: A rainy night in Osu, Ghana, sparks an unexpected connection.
cliffhanger: She discovers his identity and a secret from her past threatens everything.

scenes.narration: Rain drums on the tin roofs of Osu as Akosua sells waakye, her mother beside her. She sees a stranger being mugged and offers him her last cedis.
scenes.visual_description: A crowded street market under a downpour, umbrellas, steam rising from food stalls.

scenes.narration: Later, Kwame Asare, a wealthy CEO, approaches her with a job offer, his eyes lingering on her.
scenes.visual_description: A sleek office building with rain-streaked windows, modern interior.
